offer.text: The rituals call for things best gathered after dark. Bring me 10 rotten flesh — don't ask why.

accept.text: The dead provide, in their way. Tread carefully.

decline.text: The night keeps its secrets a while longer.

in_progress.text: Have you the flesh I asked for?

ready.text: Ten pieces, ripe and ready. The work can begin.

complete.text: You have done the temple a quiet service.
